The Tour de Wallonie is an annual multi-stage professional cycling race that takes place in the Wallonia region of Belgium. In 2019, the race was held from July 23-27.

The 2019 edition of the Tour de Wallonie consisted of 5 stages. The race started and finished in Mons. Some of the notable stage locations included Seraing, Namur, and Couvin.

The overall winner of the 2019 Tour de Wallonie was Thibaut Pinot of the Groupama–FDJ cycling team. Other top finishers included Dylan Teuns in 2nd place and Xandro Meurisse in 3rd place.

The Tour de Wallonie is one of the smaller UCI ProSeries events on the professional cycling calendar, but it attracts many top Belgian and international riders as part of their racing schedule leading up to the later-season grand tours and one-day classics.
